note: Remaining United States cost-of-attendance budgets, plus the University of Washington's annual tuition, which had never been recorded because the rate lives in a tier table rather than on the programme page. Visa-certified figures are labelled as financial requirements, not as observed averages, because a floor and a budget are different numbers.

note.en: MIT's 2026-27 graduate cost of attendance, nine-month column for the standard September-to-May academic year: housing 17,100, food 7,830, books and course materials 1,161, personal 7,794, transportation 2,844 and health insurance 5,148. MIT publishes a twelve-month column as well, used only when a student also registers for the summer session, where housing rises to 22,800 and food to 10,440.
note.tr: MIT'nin 2026-27 lisansustu egitim maliyeti, standart Eylul-Mayis akademik yili icin dokuz aylik sutun: konut 17.100, gida 7.830, kitap ve ders malzemesi 1.161, kisisel 7.794, ulasim 2.844 ve saglik sigortasi 5.148. MIT ayrica on iki aylik bir sutun yayimlar; bu sutun yalnizca ogrenci yaz donemine de kayit oldugunda kullanilir ve konut 22.800'e, gida 10.440'a yukselir.

sources.title: MIT Student Financial Services: Graduate Cost of Attendance 2026-27

note.en: Princeton's 2026-27 living-expense table, twelve-month column: housing on or off campus 17,040, food 10,925, personal expenses 9,365 and books and supplies 2,440, totalling 39,770. The ten-month column totals 33,141. Princeton publishes no separate transport line, so local travel is not inside this figure.
note.tr: Princeton'un 2026-27 yasam gideri tablosu, on iki aylik sutun: kampus ici veya disi konut 17.040, gida 10.925, kisisel giderler 9.365 ve kitap ve malzeme 2.440; toplam 39.770. On aylik sutunun toplami 33.141'dir. Princeton ayri bir ulasim satiri yayimlamaz, bu yuzden sehir ici ulasim bu rakamin icinde degildir.

sources.title: Princeton Graduate School: University Rates and Costs 2026-27

note.en: Virginia Tech's 2026-27 out-of-state graduate cost of attendance for the Blacksburg campus, stated as one academic year of fall and spring: housing 13,330, food 3,840, course materials 1,120, transportation 3,014 and personal 4,130. Direct costs of tuition 33,582 and fees 3,754 bring the published total to 62,770. The sheet adds that a first-time graduate student's budget also carries a computer allowance of 2,150 or 3,140 depending on the programme.
note.tr: Virginia Tech'in Blacksburg kampusu icin 2026-27 eyalet disi lisansustu egitim maliyeti, guz ve bahardan olusan bir akademik yil olarak belirtilir: konut 13.330, gida 3.840, ders malzemesi 1.120, ulasim 3.014 ve kisisel 4.130. Dogrudan maliyetler olan 33.582 ogrenim ucreti ve 3.754 harc ile yayimlanan toplam 62.770'e ulasir. Belge, ilk kez kayit olan bir lisansustu ogrencinin butcesinin ayrica programa gore 2.150 veya 3.140 bilgisayar odenegi tasidigini ekler.

sources.title: Virginia Tech: Estimated 2026-27 Cost of Attendance, Graduate Out-of-State

note.en: CU Boulder's 2026-27 nonresident graduate budget covers the two semesters of the academic year: housing and food 18,684, books and supplies 1,200, transportation 2,062, personal 1,782 and medical expenses 8,136, totalling 31,864. Housing and food arrive as one line, so they cannot be separated here.
note.tr: CU Boulder'in 2026-27 eyalet disi lisansustu butcesi akademik yilin iki donemini kapsar: konut ve gida 18.684, kitap ve malzeme 1.200, ulasim 2.062, kisisel 1.782 ve saglik giderleri 8.136; toplam 31.864. Konut ve gida tek satir halinde geldigi icin burada ayristirilamaz.

sources.title: CU Boulder Financial Aid: Example Cost of Attendance 2026-27

note.en: Texas A&M's twelve-month estimated cost of attendance for immigration documents puts living costs at USD 19,995 within a USD 46,015 total that assumes nonresident engineering rates and two major semesters. This is the amount the university will certify on an I-20, which is a floor for the visa rather than an observed average, and it excludes summer tuition.
note.tr: Texas A&M'in gocmenlik belgeleri icin on iki aylik tahmini egitim maliyeti, eyalet disi muhendislik oranlarini ve iki ana donemi varsayan 46.015 USD'lik toplam icinde yasam giderlerini 19.995 USD olarak belirler. Bu, universitenin I-20 uzerinde onaylayacagi tutardir; gozlemlenen bir ortalama degil vize icin bir tabandir ve yaz donemi ogrenim ucretini icermez.

sources.title: Texas A&M ISSS: 2026 Estimated Cost of Attendance, 12 months

note.en: USC certifies USD 28,044 of living expenses for a twelve-month I-20. A visa minimum is a floor the university will vouch for, not a budget: Viterbi separately estimates university housing reserved for graduate engineering students at USD 1,300 a month, or USD 15,600 across an academic year, and that is housing alone.
note.tr: USC, on iki aylik bir I-20 icin 28.044 USD yasam gideri onaylar. Vize asgari tutari, universitenin kefil oldugu bir tabandir, bir butce degildir: Viterbi ayrica lisansustu muhendislik ogrencilerine ayrilan universite konutunu ayda 1.300 USD, bir akademik yil boyunca 15.600 USD olarak tahmin eder ve bu yalnizca konuttur.

sources.title: USC Graduate Admission: Financial Documentation Requirements
USC Viterbi: Tuition and Fees for 27-Unit Master of Science Programs 2026-27

note.en: UT Austin's 2026-27 full-time graduate cost of attendance for a nonresident living on or off campus, across the fall and spring semesters at nine hours of enrolment: housing and food 17,052 to 17,423, transportation 1,840, books and course materials 776 and personal 4,900. The upper bound is used. Housing and food arrive as one line and cannot be separated.
note.tr: UT Austin'in 2026-27 tam zamanli lisansustu egitim maliyeti, kampus ici veya disinda yasayan eyalet disi bir ogrenci icin, guz ve bahar donemlerinde dokuz saatlik kayitla: konut ve gida 17.052-17.423, ulasim 1.840, kitap ve ders malzemesi 776 ve kisisel 4.900. Ust sinir kullanilir. Konut ve gida tek satir halinde gelir ve ayristirilamaz.

sources.title: UT Austin Texas One Stop: Cost of Attendance 2026-27

note.en: UC San Diego states its graduate cost of attendance is built on three quarters of full-time enrolment, so this is a nine-month figure. The off-campus food and housing line for 2026-27 is USD 31,548 within a published total of USD 76,821. Only food and housing are carried here: transportation, books, personal expenses and health insurance sit in the same official budget but were not captured as separate figures, so they must be budgeted on top.
note.tr: UC San Diego, lisansustu egitim maliyetinin tam zamanli kayitla uc ceyrek uzerine kuruldugunu belirtir; bu yuzden bu dokuz aylik bir rakamdir. 2026-27 icin kampus disi gida ve konut satiri, yayimlanan 76.821 USD'lik toplam icinde 31.548 USD'dir. Burada yalnizca gida ve konut tasinir: ulasim, kitap, kisisel giderler ve saglik sigortasi ayni resmi butcede yer alir ancak ayri rakamlar olarak kaydedilmemistir, bu yuzden ustune butcelenmelidir.

sources.title: UC San Diego Financial Aid: Graduate Cost of Attendance 2026-27

cost_notes.en: UW publishes annual full-time rates for Autumn, Winter and Spring. The MS in Aeronautics and Astronautics sits in Graduate Tier III on the university's own tier list, where the 2026-27 non-resident operating fee is USD 37,939 and the building fee USD 1,376, giving USD 39,315 of tuition. The required technology, services and activities, IMA bond and facilities renovation fees add USD 966, for USD 40,281 of tuition and fees; the U-PASS transport pass adds a further USD 243.
cost_notes.tr: UW, Guz, Kis ve Bahar icin yillik tam zamanli oranlar yayimlar. Uzay ve Havacilik Muhendisligi yuksek lisansi, universitenin kendi kademe listesinde Lisansustu Kademe III'te yer alir; burada 2026-27 eyalet disi isletme ucreti 37.939 USD ve bina ucreti 1.376 USD'dir, bu da 39.315 USD ogrenim ucreti eder. Zorunlu teknoloji, hizmet ve etkinlik, IMA tahvili ve tesis yenileme ucretleri 966 USD ekler ve ogrenim ucreti ile harclar 40.281 USD olur; U-PASS ulasim karti bunun uzerine 243 USD ekler.

note.en: UW International Student Services estimates USD 37,484 of living expenses for 2026-27 across a four-quarter year, alongside USD 2,148 of ISHIP health insurance. The tuition figure on this record covers the three-quarter academic year instead, so a student staying through summer should expect tuition on top of it as well.
note.tr: UW Uluslararasi Ogrenci Hizmetleri, 2026-27 icin dort ceyreklik bir yil boyunca 37.484 USD yasam gideri ve bunun yaninda 2.148 USD ISHIP saglik sigortasi tahmin eder. Bu kayittaki ogrenim ucreti rakami ise uc ceyreklik akademik yili kapsar; bu yuzden yaz boyunca kalan bir ogrenci ustune ogrenim ucreti de beklemelidir.
